name: UI：商家管理-生产筹备状态图标验证
description: 验证商家管理列表生产筹备状态列：check/lock图标+企划/设计/拍摄文字

steps.expression: return (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('tr.ant-table-row'); const firstRow = rows[0]; if(!firstRow) return { found: false }; const prepCell = firstRow.querySelector('td:nth-child(5)'); if(!prepCell) return { found: false }; const checks = prepCell.querySelectorAll('[class*=check]'); const locks = prepCell.querySelectorAll('[class*=lock]'); const stages = Array.from(prepCell.querySelectorAll('span')).filter(s => ['企划','设计','拍摄'].includes(s.textContent.trim())).map(s => s.textContent.trim()); return { found: true, checkCount: checks.length, lockCount: locks.length, stages }; })()

steps.description: 验证 验证筹备状态图标 存在

steps.expression: return (() => { const ths = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('th, .ant-table-thead th')); return { columnCount: ths.length, headers: ths.slice(0, 15).map(th => (th.textContent || '').trim()) }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在相关数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 筹备状态用check(完成)/lock(未完成)图标+企划/设计/拍摄文字表示
